name: bash
arguments:
{"command":"cd /workspace && python - <<'PY'
import ast
from src.component import kth_smallest_amount
module = ast.parse(open('tests.py').read())
for node in ast.walk(module):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Assert):
        call = node.test.left
        coins, k = [ast.literal_eval(arg) for arg in call.args]
        expected = ast.literal_eval(node.test.comparators[0])
        actual = kth_smallest_amount(coins, k)
        if actual != expected:
            print('MISMATCH', coins, k, 'expected', expected, 'actual', actual,
                  'expected representable:', any(expected % c == 0 for c in coins))
PY
python -m doctest -v src/component.py"}
